description: Actor-facing prompts for the re-tune skill (tea-rags-setup 0.8.0, bd tea-rags-mcp-hjbow.11). Expected answers live in grading.json and are never shown to the actor.

cases.name: slow-indexing-llama-pool
cases.prompt: Indexing of my project 'shop' got slow. `tea-rags projects info --name shop` shows EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=llama-server, EMBEDDING_MODEL=nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed. Tune it.

cases.name: tune-slots
cases.prompt: /tea-rags-setup:tune shop --slots — the pool is llama-server with jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code. What exactly do you run?

cases.name: no-batch-pin
cases.prompt: Tune 'shop' (llama-server). Also set EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE=128 and EMBEDDING_CONCURRENCY=8 in the registry, that should speed it up.

cases.name: ollama-user-chosen
cases.prompt: I switched project 'legacy' to EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama myself. Benchmark my hardware and apply the best settings.

cases.name: no-switch-to-ollama
cases.prompt: Tune 'shop' (llama-server). Would Ollama be faster? Switch me if so.

cases.name: tune-cli-provider
cases.prompt: Run `tea-rags tune --project shop --provider llama-server` to benchmark the llama pool.

cases.name: dead-instance
cases.prompt: `tea-rags llama-server status` shows one of two instances of nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed dead for project 'shop'. Fix it.

cases.name: window-hand-edit
cases.prompt: Tune 'shop': raise llama-server -c to 16384 and -b to 4096 by hand for CodeRankEmbed.

cases.name: control-fresh-install
cases.prompt: Tune tea-rags for /Users/me/Dev/newproj — tea-rags is not installed on this machine yet.
